keyInsights: Answer phone within 10 min — first tech to answer wins 70-80% of emergency calls
Emergency repairs convert at 50-65% call-to-booked, highest in home services
Precision Garage Door has 8,373 reviews — beat them on speed and personal service
Yard signs + door hangers after every job = cheapest local marketing possible
Google Business Profile: 40+ reviews at 90%+ response rate beats 100 reviews at 50%
Ponte Vedra Beach median home price $679k — least price-sensitive customers in area
Pre-listing repairs from realtors = highest-ticket, least price-sensitive jobs
First 10 customers in 45-60 days is realistic with daily execution
